storage.notes: Lifespan path: triggered (on emit) -> acknowledged (POST /api/alerts/acknowledge or auto-handler for INFO) -> resolved (POST /api/alerts/resolve) -> silenced (POST /api/alerts/silence returns silenced_until but does not yet mutate AlertStore). Status enum: triggered | acknowledged | resolved | silenced (domain.AlertStatus*). AutoHandler.Recover transitions triggered -> resolved on recovery signals. Unacknowledged alerts surface at /api/alerts/unacknowledged.

notes: There are three largely independent alert pipelines with overlapping scope and inconsistent naming: (1) Prometheus rules under monitoring/rules/ (consumed externally by Prometheus/Alertmanager), (2) in-process Monitor.Alert → AlertStore (JSONL/Postgres) + optional Notifier fan-out, and (3) Alertmanager webhook handlers in internal/alerting/. Naming is not unified: Go rule IDs use snake_case (data-staleness-critical, prediction-drift, simulation, etf_nav, background_task) while Prometheus alert names use CamelCase (ChannelHighErrorRatePerChannel, AtlasDBInitFailure, LLMAnnotatorHighErrorRateFastBurn). Stages use category-as-rule-string for deduplication key ("category:LEVEL"); Prometheus uses alertname label. The MCP layer is Phase 1 partial — only 3 read-only tools (alert_list, alert_get_stats, alert_get_rules) are registered; ack/resolve/silence/silence-bulk are only on the HTTP API (internal/monitoring/alert_api.go) and have no MCP counterparts. AutoHandler in production auto-acknowledges INFO alerts immediately (autohandler.go Handle step 1) so they never surface in /api/alerts/unacknowledged — lifecycle is ack-resolved for non-INFO but effective fire-and-forget for INFO. No agent-startup alert-scanning mechanism exists: there is no equivalent of 'on boot, load all triggered alerts from store and re-surfaced through MCP/HTTP' — alerts only enter the AlertStore via live emit. DualWriteRepository.LoadAllAlerts / LoadUnacknowledgedAlerts exist but no caller in cmd/atlas wires them to a startup rescan (zero matches for ScanAlertsOnStartup / RecoverAlerts / ResurrectAlerts in cmd/atlas/main.go and related files).
